statement: There are 480 irreducible nodal plane cubics through 4 general points and properly tangent to 4 general lines.

source.location: Theorem III, §3, table column D, author preprint printed page 22
source.version: Author-hosted 30-page preprint, Theorem III, printed page 22

Source specialization: Entry k=4 of Theorem III, column D; proper tangencies.

Aluffi explicitly identifies these characteristic numbers as classical results of Maillard and Zeuthen. Those original claims and Aluffi’s rigorous verification are both cited; the modern proof is not presented as the first numerical claim. Any singleton real or monodromy assertion here is a deduction from the count.
